articles.headline: Derek McInnes left 'mortified' after Rangers knocked out of Conference League on penalties
articles.description: Rangers were left reeling as they crashed out of the UEFA Conference League play-offs with a 4-3 penalty shoot-out defeat to Jablonec in the Stadion Strelnice.

images.name: Rangers [1296x729]
images.caption: Rangers were knocked out of the Conference League in the playoff round.
images.alt: Rangers Lawrence Shankland consoles Findlay Curtis at Full Time during a UEFA Europa Conference League Playoff Round Second Leg match between FK Jablonec and Rangers at the Chance Arena, on August 27, 2026, in Jablonec nad Nisou, Czech Republic.
images.credit: Craig Foy/SNS Group via Getty Images

images.name: Derek McIness [1296x729]
images.caption: It was another difficult evening for Derek McIness as Rangers manager.
images.alt: Rangers Manager Derek McInnes at Full Time during a UEFA Europa Conference League Playoff Round Second Leg match between FK Jablonec and Rangers at the Chance Arena, on August 27, 2026, in Jablonec nad Nisou, Czech Republic
